title: WhatsApp — E2E Encryption
subtitle: Signal Protocol: X3DH and Double Ratchet

nodes.label:
Double Ratchet
New key per msg

panels.title: Forward Secrecy
panels.body:
Compromising the current key does
not reveal past messages. Each
message has its own unique key.

panels.title: Server's Role
panels.body:
The server stores encrypted blobs.
It cannot decrypt content as it
never sees the private keys.
